en.title: Inde Navarrette Faces Aliens, Floods, and Crocodiles in 'The Waffle House Index'
en.summary: Fresh off her breakout role in 'Obsession,' Inde Navarrette is set to star in the ambitious sci-fi thriller 'The Waffle House Index.' The film promises a wild ride through apocalyptic scenarios centered around a seemingly ordinary diner.
en.body:
After captivating audiences as the lead in **Obsession**, **Inde Navarrette** is diving headfirst into a world of chaos and cosmic threats. She's slated to star in **The Waffle House Index**, a new sci-fi thriller that sounds like it throws every disaster movie trope into a blender and hits 'puree.' This project marks a significant step for Navarrette, who is also executive producing, underscoring her growing influence behind the scenes.

The film, produced by **Apple** and **Brad Pitt**’s **Plan B Entertainment**, takes its title from an informal system used to gauge the severity of hurricanes based on the operational status of Waffle House restaurants. However, the movie's scope quickly expands far beyond meteorological events. The screenplay, penned by **Andrew Nunnelly**, who previously produced the Netflix series **Chambers**, centers on a Waffle House waitress whose already difficult night shift takes a turn for the apocalyptic.

What follows is a dizzying escalation of events that reportedly includes a mass flood, killer crocodiles, a nuclear explosion, and, perhaps most intriguingly, a magical bunker located beneath the Waffle House itself, all while aliens loom. The transition from a simple stranger with a gun to an intergalactic crisis is a narrative leap that **THR** notes was secured for a seven-figure sum, hinting at the script's ambitious scope and potential. Directing this whirlwind of destruction is **Louis Paxton**, whose recent feature debut, **The Incomer**, is set to arrive in theaters, adding another layer of anticipation for his distinctive vision.

## A World Under Siege

Navarrette's casting in **The Waffle House Index** is particularly exciting for fans who were enthralled by her nuanced performance in **Obsession**. The prospect of her leading a high-concept sci-fi thriller, especially one involving such a diverse array of threats, suggests a role that will allow her to showcase a wide range of acting prowess. The film’s blend of grounded, everyday settings with extraordinary, genre-bending elements—from natural disasters to extraterrestrial encounters—positions it as a potential standout in the crowded sci-fi landscape. The involvement of **Plan B Entertainment**, known for its critically acclaimed projects, further bolsters the film's prestige and the expectation of a compelling narrative.

## What's Next

While specific release dates for **The Waffle House Index** have not yet been announced, **Inde Navarrette** is also set to appear as Rogue in Jake Schreier's upcoming **X-Men** film. Fans can anticipate more details about **The Waffle House Index** as production progresses, with the film expected to arrive on Apple Original Films.

By Molly Templeton | Published on September 4, 2026 Image: Focus Features Comment 0 Share New Share Obsession ’s Inde Navarrette Will Star in The Waffle House Index &url= target=”_blank” title=”Twitter”> Obsession ’s Inde Navarrette Will Star in The Waffle House Index ” target=”_blank” title=”Pinterest”> Image: Focus Features After a breakout role in Obsession , Inde Navarrette has begun to line up an intriguing late of new projects. She’s already Rogue (in Jake Schreier’s upcoming X-Men film), and now she’s set to star in The Waffle House Index , which The Hollywood Reporter calls “a sci-fi thriller package.” While the Waffle House Index , in non-cinematic form, is a funky way to estimate the intensity of a storm via the state of a region’s Waffle Houses, The Waffle House Index is about a Waffle House employee who is having a different kind of terrible experience. The screenplay is by Andrew Nunnelly (a producer on the Netflix series Chambers ), and THR says it “centers on a Waffle House waitress whose already bad day gets worse when a stranger with a gun shows up during her night shift. What happens after involves a mass flood, killer crocodiles, a nuclear explosion, a magical bunker under the Waffle House, and aliens.” How we get from “stranger with a gun” to “nuclear explosion” I can only begin to imagine. According to THR , “Sources say the deal for the script was seven figures.” Louis Paxton will direct. Most of his work has been shorts and British TV series, but his debut feature film, The Incomer , arrives in theaters later in September. It sounds very different than the Waffle House —it’s about two strange siblings on an isolated Scottish isle who have to deal with the man sent to evict them—but it does sound similarly unpredictable and offbeat. If you want to see Navarrette before then, her star turn in Curry Barker’s Obsession is currently available on-demand on many platforms, and is also streaming on Peacock. She was also in 13 Reasons Why and Superman & Lois . The Waffle House Index does not yet have a release date, but it’s been picked up by Apple Original Films.[end-mark] The post Obsession’s Inde Navarrette Will Star in The Waffle House Index appeared first on Reactor .
